shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifted drag card, primary-button hover, hero demo board.

shadows.name: neon-bloom
shadows.value: radial-gradient(closest-side, rgb(46 230 255 / calc(0.22 * var(--glow))), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(closest-side, rgb(164 107 255 / calc(0.2 * var(--glow))), transparent 75%); filter: blur(24px)

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: All state transitions (200ms) and the needle-drop reveal.

motion.name: needle-drop
motion.value: y 10px to 0, opacity 0.35-0.4 to 1, 0.5-0.6s, 60ms stagger, once
motion.purpose: Entry of tracklist rows and demo-board tasks.

components.name: Outline Button

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 600 0.875rem/1 var(--font-archivo, Archivo, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Input

components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; width: 100%; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--input) 30%, var(--stock)); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 var(--font-archivo, Archivo, sans-serif); transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 16.5rem; padding: 24px 16px; background: var(--stock); border-right: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1 var(--font-archivo, Archivo, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-item.is-active { background: var(--accent); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-item.is-active svg { color: var(--electric); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Every project reads like the credits page of the record it will become. The ground is midnight-navy booklet stock; the type is set like an album's credits: heavy expanded italic titles that echo the poster wordmark, condensed caps for roles, tabular mono for every number (track number, BPM, key, duration, date). Information is arranged as credits, with a role on the left, a dotted leader, and the name on the right, held between hairline rules rather than inside boxed cards.

The logo's cyan-to-blue-to-violet gradient is the only light source in the world. It appears in four places: primary actions, the moving edge of a drag (the lifted card's border and its drop slot), live in-motion fills (audio playback and upload progress), and soft blooms placed behind a focal element. Everything at rest stays navy. Density is calm on marketing and comfortable-compact in the app; the board is the centrepiece and the rest of the interface supports it.

Dark is the default ("midnight booklet"). The light theme is a designed day sleeve, not an inversion: cool white stock, navy ink and the same gradient, with blooms dimmed to 35%. Both themes ship every token below; frontmatter keys are prefixed `midnight-` and `day-` and map one-to-one onto the same CSS custom properties (`--background`, `--stock`, `--rule`, `--electric` and so on) in `src/app/globals.css`, which is the normative source.
keyCharacteristics: Credits layout: role, dotted leader, name, between hairline rules.
One light source: the logo gradient, reserved for actions, motion and blooms.
Three type voices from two families: expanded heavy italic titles, condensed caps roles, tabular mono figures.
Dark default plus a fully designed day sleeve.
One staggered "needle drop" reveal; no scattered hover effects.
All icons are lucide line icons. No emoji anywhere, including reactions.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: The logo gradient is the only light. Use it for primary actions, the moving edge of a drag, live in-motion fills and blooms. Progress rules at rest, priority labels, chips and headings stay solid and quiet.

rules.name: The At-Rest Navy Rule
rules.body: A static progress bar is solid ink at 70% on a muted track. Colour arrives only with motion or intent.

rules.name: The One Numeric Voice Rule
rules.body: Every number that a musician reads (BPM, key, time, count, date) is set in tabular mono. Prose numbers such as "50 MB" in a sentence stay in body type.

rules.name: The Clean Glyph Rule
rules.body: Body text turns off common ligatures (`font-variant-ligatures: no-common-ligatures`) and uses `text-rendering: geometricPrecision`. Archivo's fi/fl ligatures and hinting open visible gaps at the width-axis default on Chromium and Linux. Keep both settings on any new root.

rules.name: The Credits Line Rule
rules.body: Titles are never preceded by a kicker or eyebrow. If a title needs a supporting line, it sits below the title as a credits line in role type.

rules.name: The Credits Block Rule
rules.body: Group facts as credits: role, dotted leader (`1px dotted` in the rule color, lifted 0.3em), value right-aligned, rows between a rule-coloured top and bottom hairline. Use this before reaching for a grid of cards.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces get the sheet shadow at most. Lift belongs to motion and hover on primary actions.

dos: **Do** reserve the logo gradient for primary actions, the moving edge of a drag, live playback/upload fills and blooms behind a focal element.
**Do** set every musician-facing number (BPM, key, time, count, date) in tabular JetBrains Mono.
**Do** present facts as credits: role, dotted leader, value, between rule hairlines.
**Do** place a title's supporting line below it in role type, as a credits line.
**Do** show the logo mark beside the title it labels (the demo board, the closing panel), with its blue glow at display sizes.
**Do** keep `font-variant-ligatures: no-common-ligatures` and `text-rendering: geometricPrecision` on body text.
**Do** design both themes for every new surface: midnight booklet and day sleeve.
**Do** use lucide line icons at 12 to 16px for meta and 16px in buttons.
donts: **Don't** put a kicker or eyebrow above a title.
**Don't** fill progress rules, priority labels, chips or headings with the gradient at rest; static progress is solid ink at 70%.
**Don't** put a neon bloom behind or on top of text.
**Don't** use emoji, including for reactions; use lucide icons.
**Don't** add decorative hover motion (scale, translate, staggered effects); hover changes colour, border or shadow only, and the needle-drop entry is the only choreographed motion.
**Don't** use semantic colours as fills; warning, destructive and success colour text only.
